name: Chorus
notes: Hosted AI employees (marketing, chief of staff, ops, data, finance, engineering or custom) that each run on an always-on cloud computer, connect to business tools, keep a persistent memory, and are messaged through iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack or Microsoft Teams.
